title: Actual OBJECTS fields and commented source qualification
scope: Actual per-field OBJECTS observations and ignored-comment-safe selected VisualStyle/dictionary source mapping; original physical transport/proof only, with full rendering/native/edited/output qualification still open.
implementation: Add separate public physical-source DTO/view and an optional independent limits policy. Existing facade/model/source-view layouts and DRW_Interface/existing-facet slots are unchanged.

Latch the existing resource/dictionary opt-in once before the object body. A bounded actual reader observer records code/ordinal/byte spans and ignored comments, chains/restores prior observers, seals at the actual next code0 and retains a shared logical read-budget lease.

Expose metadata only within actual typed/raw/source publications; repeated getters allocate nothing and borrow model/raw pointers only during callbacks. Shared immutable physical owners survive callback return/throw and reader destruction.
Bind the exact physical owner/status across actual rendering and dictionary phases. Account retained physical bytes and source qualification workspaces, including comments.

Replace no-gap ordinal inference with complete observed field mapping for VisualStyle, NOD and style dictionary. Check whole-read record boundaries/version/encoding/name, every scalar ordinal/code/offset and the exact kept raw-code sequence; skip only observed ignored999 records.

Keep metadata quota/allocation failures separate from tolerant typed import and retained modeled replay. Preserve explicit failure states, original ownership/dependency checks and corrected retries. No native DWG layout or writer admission change.

controls.collectorSchedule: Faults isolated to the actual collector constructor and actual observed-scalar dispatch; real reader and generic/identity parent observers run outside injection. Finite offsets0..63, stop after two consecutive unreached offsets. Correct each attempt; validate both observer chains and retained lease release.
controls.fixtures: Runtime-authored literal recipes only; no external drawing payload, conversion or derivative committed

development: Initial strict compilation caught misleading indentation in the converter mapper and an ignored nodiscard test read result; correct both without weakening -Werror.

The new CTest is inserted before existing trailing consumer tests. Initial append-only registration-order assertion failed before builds started; derive actual registration order and separately prove all previous102 names retain their relative order. No build was live and no failed qualification was represented as passing.

Archive inclusion review exposed macOS AppleDouble metadata. Preserve the initial288-member archives, disable copyfile metadata in the isolated make-dist environment and assert clean archives. The resulting144 members preserve every non-metadata entry exactly; this is not full source-release build qualification.
limits: Physical metadata contains no scalar values/role/semantic certificate, and Complete does not prove whole-import success.
Quotas measure logical retained bytes/work, not vector capacity or process RSS. Independent policy limits/allocation preserve ordinary reads; aggregate shared read limits remain authoritative.

Selected source qualification still requires a complete canonical primary VisualStyle shape. Optional/absent/duplicate/foreign/legacy/extension and RenderSettings producer/version shapes and named roots remain open.

Nine resource families, ATTDEF rawTypedMatched=false, support ledger CLOSED, full owner/recursive/output flags false. No native rendering, peer/kernel semantic, formal ABI/application, controlled memory/performance or full source-release build claim.
J256/J260/J268/J284/J293/J295 remain DEFERRED_EXTERNAL. Native Linux/Windows FreeCAD and independent ACIS/ACDS semantic/kernel qualification remain NOT_RUN.
next: Complete independent producer/version-qualified rendering profiles and real RenderSettings named roots; keep optional/absent/extension semantics witness-driven.
Finish background/live-section/sun, VIEWPORT clipping/layer overrides, remaining owner/name/application/XDATA/HEADER dependencies and recursive/coupled/whole-document ownership.

Finish live/emitted/TABLE closure, full B2b/B3/C native/version/corpus obligations,42-file legacy release inventory/source build, controlled memory/performance and LibreCAD/LibreCAD_3/FreeCAD/external qualification.
